<div class="single-holder">
	<div class="article">
		<h1 class="headline">3 Mile Camp Tariffs 2026</h1>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">Tariffs are advised in Australian Dollars, including all compulsory Government or regulatory charges (e.g. GST).</p>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">Below mentioned tariffs, as well as additional tariffs may apply, are to be read in conjunction with:<br><a style="color:orange" href="http://gnaraloostation.com/3-mile-camp-booking-terms-and-conditions/"> Booking Terms and Conditions</a> and <a style="color:orange" href="https://gnaraloostation.com/know-before-you-go/">Know before you go</a>.</p>
<hr class="wp-block-coblocks-dynamic-separator is-style-fullwidth" style="height:20px"/>
<p class="has-text-align-center has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">3 Mile Camp &#8211; Off Peak Period Rates</p>
<p class="has-text-align-center has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Dates outside Standard Period and Peak Period</p>
